name: Pentax Spotmatic
note: a 1964 mechanical SLR cannot have a sensor. The value was the literal string 'film' — an upstream source using a sensor_size column to record the film type. It surfaced when the 'Asahi Pentax Spotmatic' duplicate was folded in and the winner inherited it, which is the gate working as designed.

name: Canon EOS 3
note: same defect, value 'Film'. The EOS 3 is a 1998 35mm film SLR.

name: Canon FTb
note: same defect, value '135 film'. The FTb is a 1971 mechanical 35mm SLR. Both of these predate this change and were already inside the baseline ceiling; blanking them lowers it rather than merely holding it.
